# Original upstream notice boundaries

The original `esbuild` 0.28.1 package declares MIT. Its unchanged [LICENSE.md](source/node_modules/esbuild/LICENSE.md) is included in full:

Copyright (c) 2020 Evan Wallace

Keep that original copyright and permission/warranty text with copies or substantial portions of the software. Original source comments and package documentation are unchanged.

The `@esbuild/linux-x64` 0.28.1 manifest separately declares MIT and the same upstream repository. Its included README describes a Linux binary package, but this snapshot contains only that manifest and README. No binary is distributed here, and no separate platform-package license body is invented.

This is an exact installed-text snapshot. It neither asserts pristine upstream distribution equivalence nor relicenses upstream implementations as CRAYS-owned AGPL code. It is not a comprehensive legal, preferred-source, dependency or reproducibility assessment.
